notes.title: Update 1.7.0 announcement
notes.content:
Dear Nordicandia Players, 

A new update has arrived, bringing with it a wave of improvements, fixes, and fresh seasonal flair!  

Here’s what’s new: 

- UI/UX improvements – 7 blocks of visual and functional refinements for a smoother in-game experience. 
- Skip Tutorial – Already know the ropes? You can now skip the tutorial and jump right in! 
- Opals in Main Menu – Track your precious gems directly from the main screen. 
- Bug Fixes – We’ve squashed some annoying bugs to keep your adventure running smoothly. 
- Statue of Freya – The goddess of love now watches over your journey! This isn't just eye candy — it’s a unique interactive element. 
- Falling Petals – Embrace the season with soft petals gently drifting through your adventure. 

May Freya's blessings guide you as you battle, loot, and explore. See you in the world of Nordicandia!  

With love, 
The Nordicandia Team

notes.title: Major Update and new Season 6!
notes.content:
Greetings Vikings! I know you've been waiting for this for a long time. We present you a new update in Nordicandia with Season 6!

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0
notes.content:
Major:
- Added 104 new skill masteries in total, distributed over all classes
- All idle mastery buffs now have max level 6, up from 5, which means a longer possible idle buff duration
- Fixed a bug where skeletons could become invulnerable with Bone Link

Minor:
-  Added some additional stats in the attribute window, such as:
  * Blocked damage taken multiplier
  * Reduced critical strike damage taken
  * Amplify/Reduce all damage taken
- Fixed a bug where newly summoned minions would get killed immediately due to the max number of minions cap, the oldest minion will now be killed instead.
- Fixed flat life regen bonus that was being multiplied incorrectly with some sources, additive life regen increases are now applied before giving flat life regen bonuses.
- Enabled V-Sync by default in the video settings
- Reduced Titanium Ore drop rate to be more in-line with the availability of iron
- Necromancer Bone Link now affects a maximum number of skeletons, which can be increased by masteries
- Necromancer summons now have a maximum duration of before despawning, 30 seconds for Death, 45 seconds for Demons and 60 seconds for Skeletons.
- Necromancer Bone Link now reduces linked targets damage taken by 30%, down from 40%
- Necromancer Bone Link mastery "Improved link" now reduces linked targets damage taken by 2% per point, down from 3%
  The lowest duration remaining per minion is displayed on the buff icon.
- Warrior Incremental Fortress mastery "Heavy Fortress" now reduced mana regen by -1% per point instead of -2%.
- Warrior War Stomp mastery "Force of the Minotaur" now increases radius by 6% per point, down from 8%.
- Warrior Hunger increased base duration to 7 seconds, up from 5.
- Hunter Power Shot fixed piercing that wasn't always piercing when it should
- Hunter Summon Wolf mastery "Vigor" now increases wolf health bonus by 20% per mastery point, up from 10%
- Hunter Summon Wolf mastery "Spirit Wolf" now increases spirit wolf health and attack speed bonus by 20% per mastery point, up from 10%
- Hunter Impaling Trap mastery "Poisoned Edged" now increases mana cost by 10% per mastery point, down from 20%
- Hunter Multishot mastery "Broadside" now shoots 1 extra arrow per mastery point, down from 2 (increasing the damage done per arrow)
- Hunter Thorns mastery "Deep Cuts" now deals 20% of the damage reflected as bleeding per second per mastery point, up from 2%
- Hunter Frozen Arrow mastery "Crystallize" now has maximum level 20 instead of 40, with 4% slowed target attacks per mastery point, up from 2%
- Mage Tornado mastery "Seeker" can now seek to the nearest target even if there's only 1 nearby enemy

notes.title: Version 1.4.0
notes.content:
The new season 5 changes will be delivered incrementally within a few days, and this is the first patch.
The next patch will contain new skill masteries, and then item sockets and new merchants, such as the set item NPC and portal NPC.

Major:
- Added new crafting materials:
  Steel, which is obtainable by smelting Iron and Essences at the Disassembler.
  Steel is used for smelting Titansteel and will also be a currency used for new merchants.
  
  Titanium Ore, a rare blacksmith material which drops from monsters of Tier 15 and above.
  
  Titansteel, which is obtainable by smelting Steel and Titanium Ore.
  Titansteel is used for essence crafting with heating stones, which allow you to upgrade one affix per item to SS rarity.
  SS affixes cannot be extracted by disassembling.
  
- Heating Stone changes
  When heating affixes of rarity AAAAA or below, the maximum success rate is increased to 25%.
  When heating an S affix (to obtain SS), the maximum success rate is 100%, but requires Titansteel, and the durability loss by overheating is halved.

- Added new pets:
  Baby Dragon: Increases loot inventory by 1 row, with 30 minutes base auto battle.
  Eagle: Increases your movement speed by 10%, with end level chest rewards.
  Larva: Increases crafting reagent drop chance, with end level chest rewards.
  Snake: Auto opens nearby loot chests, with end level chest rewards.
  
- Increased maxium world stage to 35

Minor:
- Whirlwind can now crit, be dodged and blocked
- Fixed whirlwind interaction with objects such as the end stage chest

Balance changes:
- Reduced base crit chance of axes
- Reduced base damage of Groa Set Wand
- Reduced Deadly Axe deadly strike chance
- Reduced Shield of Infinite Strength more strength% from block
- Slightly reduced unique drop rates
- Slightly reduced Demon shadowbolt damage from Unholy Rage

notes.title: Patch 1.3.4
notes.content:
Major
- Added 88 new unique items
- Added 3 new Necromancer item sets
- Greatly reduced flat force field affix scaling (not retroactively)
- Increased flat evasion affix scaling (not retroactively)
- Added new Warrior skill: Whirlwind
- Necromancer now has equal chance to find Heavy, Medium and Light armors, since Necromancer have set item options for all base types.
- Fixed Guild Siege where monsters weren't moving on start

Minor
- Reduced chance of finding weapons (meaning that it's more likely to find armor pieces now compared to before)
- Added a new general mastery for Necromancer Shadowbolt
- Added a 9-set bonus to The Dreadnought set
- Added mixology to Necromancer skills
- Reduced audio volume of Necromancer Unholy Rage spellcast
- Minion bonuses to necromancer minions such as the master summoner passive and other sources now increases the base value by x% instead of giving a flat +x% (except for Gift of The Vampire, which gives +x% since minions do not inherit any leech by default)
- Improved Mage Tornado and Thunderstrike graphics
- Since leech also applies to damage over time, the weakest leech instance is now removed when adding a new one when you're at max number of leech stacks, instead of discarding the new stack.
  This should also help reaching your leech cap more efficiently when you have a high health pool or multiple sources of low leech stacks.
- Fixed Necromancer Astral Walk that didn't always teleport minions with you
- Fixed Hunter Mana arrows that wasn't triggering Idle Powershot
- Fixed so that moved items are automatically synced with server before exiting
- Fixed the "move all items" button and double clicking an item that wasn't moving any items from the Recovered Stash
- Fixed minions that weren't updating stats in realtime such as when assigning attributes
- Fixed some skills with idle mastery that weren't auto-cast correctly due to range issues
- Fixed damage weapon conversion that wasn't calculated properly for elemental damage
- When you are muted in chat it now prints the duration you are muted for

Balance updates
- Increased monster health by ~25%
- Reduced flat force field bonus from mindpower
- Reduced Necromancer minion attack speed inheritance by 20%
- Reduced Mage Ice Nova base freeze duration by 1 second
- Increased Mage Elemental Seal radius
- Increased Tornado attraction mastery attraction speed (how fast enemies are drawn into the tornado) and attraction radius
- Slightly reduced flat armor affix scaling (not retroactively)
- Increased the resistance build-up on monsters each time they are stunned or frozen to 49%, rendering them immune to freeze and stun when they have 100% resistance or more
- Increased the knockback build-up on monsters each time they are knocked back to 19%, rendering them immune to knockback when they have more than 100% resistance or more
- Odr totem's fire and cold cast speeds have been reduced.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.7
notes.content:
Major
- Added the Essence stash page which stores up to 30 essences of each type, for a total of ~1800 Essences.
  You can easily get an overview of your essences in this page, and filter/search for specific types, similar to the list at the Blacksmith.
  This page is unlockable by purchase, and is permanent for your account and all game modes.

- The Relic Stash page and Blacksmith stash page cash purchases are now permanent for your account and all game modes.
  (A stash purchase made in any game mode will unlock that page for the current Hardcore Season, Softcore Season and all future Seasons, and also Normal hardcore/softcore)
  This change is retroactive for any existing relic/blacksmith purchases already made.
  These pages are no longer unlockable using opals.

- Premium Stash pages are no longer upgradable using opals, but are permanent for your account and all game modes when purchased (only applies to new cash purchases).
  Premium Stash upgrades come in bundles of 5 pages.
  
- Stash page item filters
  Premium pages now includes a configurable item filter, where you can allow the stash page to hold specific items or item types based on filter parameters.
  This allows your to automatically move items from your inventory to the matching stash page(s) according to your filter (when double clicking an item from your inventory, or moving all of them using the "Move to stash" button)
  The Relic, Blacksmith and Essence pages comes with a built-in filter for the corresponding item types. (Relic and Blacksmith item types are not configurable in the item filter)
  If the matching filter's page is full when moving items, they will not be moved to that page, but to the current stash page if there's room and if there's no active filter on the current page, otherwise they won't be moved at all.
  Premium pages have no filter by default.
  
- Added items to loot filters (and premium stash filters), allowing you to filter on specific items along with item types.
  For game modes such as Season, the Stash page settings (and filters) will be migrated when entering a new season, so you don't need to re-create them.
  
Minor
- Added a stash bundle where you can purchase the Essence, Relic, Blacksmith and 10 premium pages at a discounted price.
- Added armor piercing to stat calculations in the character sheet and to the monster stats in the dungeon level selection, so that physical dps is correctly displayed.
- Dungeon level selection and character sheet statistics now always calculate player (and monster) stats according to the highest monster level in the last dungeon (instead of the average or lowest monster level).
- Doubled the crafting animation speed
- Added dodged attacks to scrolling combat text
- Added a counter to the idle backflip, how many times it has been cast per minute
- The regular Blacksmith Hammer now re-rolls unique item affixes as well, instead of the Enchanted Blacksmith Hammer.
- Fixed a bug where monsters sometimes got stuck in the Guild Siege
- Fixed a bug where Hunter Wolf sometimes got stuck
- Fixed the targeting of some idle auto-cast spells, so it doesn't target monsters outside your attack range
- Fixed the tutorial for equipping a new item
- Fixed an issue where portal stats were re-rolled when entering
- Fixed an issue where the character sometimes stopped before opening the end-level chest

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
Preface
This is the season 3 patch which will release later today, and the main focus this patch has been to add the Guild Competitions.
Since guild competitions are a major and time-consuming feature, some other features have been slightly delayed, but will be released a couple of days after season launch.
The delayed features are: new unique items, the premium essence stash page and guild leaderboards (with guild rewards)

But fear not!
Season 3 will have more continuous updates with improvements and more exciting content, including new end-game options.
The developer will host a Q&A session on our Discord March 24:th at 16:00 UTC (two hours before Season 3 start), where you can ask questions.

Here's what's included in this patch:

Major - Guild Sieges
- Guild Sieges have arrived!
  A Guild Siege is a competition between two guilds.

  Each participant (character) enters their own arena instance, and battles against waves of increasingly stronger monsters, while trying to defend the center Runestone.
  The winning Guild will receive points (and the losing Guild will lose points) and climb the ranks of the Guild Leaderboard (released later), where you can claim guild rewards such as new guild badges.
  This system has been designed to allow for as many matchmaking options as possible, while also allowing players from different time zones to compete together.
  I plan to expand on the guild points system later on with some guild-wide benefits and leadership choices.
  You need to be level 10K to participate in a Guild Siege.
  
  * Siege Rounds
  The Siege creation round starts every Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 18:00 UTC, and is open for the selected guild members to join for 24 hours.
  A character may join a siege once per round.
  When the creation round ends, the challenge round starts immediately after and is open for another 24 hours.
  Your Guild has to create a Siege before you can participate in the challenge round.
  
  * Creating a Siege
  There are currently 3v3, 5v5 and 10v10 sieges available.
  Select which guild members you want to participate in the Siege this round.
  You can create as many sieges as you want per round (24h), to allow all guild members to join a siege. 
  Only characters in game mode you select can join the siege (hardcore and softcore are separate).
  Achieve a good siege result by killing as many high level monsters as you can.
  
  * Challenging another Guild's Siege:
  "Find Siege" will matchmake your selected team against another guild's created Siege.
  Challenging participants can then choose their opponent and try to beat their score by joining the battle and killing higher level monsters than the opponent.
  The opponent siege results will not be visible when selecting your opponent, only their character level.
  
  * How to win a Siege
  The Guild with the most battle wins against their opponent will win the Guild Siege, and receive a higher reward.
  Rewards can be claimed in the Guild Siege window by each participant, and are available as soon as all participants have challenged an opponent, or when the challenge round ends.
  Each participant also gains a loot reward immediately after the battle, depending on how many monsters that were killed.

Major (continued)

- Doubled the monster quantity in Helheim (inherently increasing the number of Relic of Blessing's dropped)
- Adjusted several unique item stats, including improving the stats on many of the unique caster weapons.

Minor:
- Tiny Movement speed potions can now drop from monsters
- Shields can now spawn Less Skill Cooldown affixes
- Added option to disable the pause dialog when approaching a boss
- Fixed some tooltips that were incorrectly displayed
- Fixed ability to reset your registered email password

Unique item balance changes:

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
- Season 2 will start the 9th of December at 18:00 UTC!

Major
- Added Premium Relic Stash page, where you can store your relics (crafting materials) with unlimited stack size.
  This is unlockable both with Opals and through purchase.
- Added Premium Stash pages, these allow you to change Color, Name and the order of the page in your stash.

- Added new magic find set for Mages
- Added 75 new avatar frames across all tiers
- Increased maximum playable stage level to 30-10 (this will be increased further in the future)
- Added new unique items, where some can drop from level 1, and some only drop on higher levels.
- The auto-cast cooldown for all auto-cast idle masteries now scale with mastery level, starting at 0-5 seconds at level 1, and 0-1 seconds at level 5.
  This will attempt to auto-cast skills at a higher rate (but the underlying skill cooldown still applies).
- Added new weapon item types: One-handed Crossbows and One-handed Wands, these are faster than their two-handed versions and can be dual-wielded (wands can also be combined with an off-hand item). Dual-wielding gives 30% more attackspeed.
  These items can be reinforced using Staff reinforcement and Bow reinforcements accordingly.
- Added new off-hand item type: Tomes, these give implicit force field and chance to block spells.
- Maximum obtainable portal/helheim level is now 10x the maximum unlocked world level (capped at 31-10)
- Greatly reduced flat force field scaling on affixes and flat force field bonus from mindpower.
  Existing items are not adjusted retroactively, but re-rolling affix values will apply the new scaling. 

Major (continued)
- Evasion changes:
  If you or your target does not evade the attack, another roll is performed (equal to the chance to evade) to see if the hit was a glancing hit.
  Glancing hits deals 50% of the total damage as a debuff over time (base duration 1 second) instead of an immediate hit.
  Glancing hits cannot leech. The damage type of the debuff is equal to the most dominant damage type of the hit.
- Adjusted the drop rates for all armor types so that all types are now equally probable to drop (helmet, shoulders, chest, etc..)
  Also increased drop rates for belt and cloak to give a more uniform drop experience, this should make it easier to find complete sets.
  Heavy/Medium/Light armors are still biased depending on the class you play.
- Season leaderboard rewards are now based on class, so each class has the chance to gain rewards independantly from each other.
- Christmas event will start the 16:th of December where you can get daily presents from the christmas tree in Town.
- Fixed an issue preventing your from accessing the Recovered Stash in Town for hardcore season characters.

Minor
- Attribute allocation now has an option to show a preview of the stat changes if allocating all your points, so you no longer need to click each one to see the changes.
- Added damage taken conversion stats and is also displayed in player attributes. All conversions are applied together, so 10% damage taken as fire and 10% damage taken as lightning results in a net 20% damage conversion.
  If total conversion is over 100% then it's normalized to 100% (60% + 80% conversion becomes 43%+57% net conversion)
- Wolf king boss no longer causes stun if you stand behind him during his charge.
- Bolomahl boss is now a bit slower to perform his special attack
- Fixed: Assigning a potion to a slot now correctly starts its cooldown
- Fixed: Hunter Mark of the Chosen, Automark: no longer casts the mark as soon as the cooldown finishes
- Fixed: Odr will no longer awaken if he's hit before the player passes the flame on the ground
- Fixed: "Lock items"-button at the Merchant no longer discards all items.
- Fixed: Yellow arrow icons no longer show on items if the item is imbued
- Fixed: Attributes view: Visual calculation of "estimated leech stack duration" 

Item balance changes
- Shields can now spawn All Resist affixes
- All melee weapons splash damage can now crit
- Increased base armor and block chance on Shields
- Ring Lokulfs Wisdom now gives +2 to passive skills
- Bow Heartpiercer now has 15% chance to pierce
- Ring Dimensional Loop now gives 8% more item quantity in Niflheim and gives 15% more portal drops (scales with level)
- Scavenger set now has 30% chance to find additional iron on drop, and does not affect the end-level chest, also slightly reduced the scaling of max number of quantity stacks.
- Reduced affix values for mana gained on kill, life leech and critical strike chance
- Increased base weapon damage affix on amulets by 200% 

Warrior balance changes
- Warrior Slam, added new general mastery: Shockwave, that creates up to 2 additional shockwaves 30 degrees apart from the target direction. A target may only be hit once per Slam.
- Warrior Frenzy dual mastery (active): Increased chance to dual strike to 2% per mastery point 

Hunter balance changes
- Hunter wolf is now immune to Slow curse
- Hunter Backflip, increased base backflip movement speed
- Hunter Power shot, increased projectile radius to 8 units and base pierce chance to 95%
- Hunter Power shot piercing arrows (active), now also adds 2% armor piercing per level and has 1% additional chance to pierce per level
- Hunter fork passive, reduced max chance to 20%
- Hunter Impaling trap, increased radius to 25 units and base damage multiplier to 750%
- Hunter rapid fire (active), increased bonus attack speed to 310%, reduced buff and immobilization duration to 4 seconds.
- Hunter double draw passive, reduced max chance to 30%
- Hunter frozen arrow rapid freeze (active), no longer reduces freeze radius
- Hunter multishot broadside mastery, each arrow can now hit the same target 

Mage balance changes
- Mage Tornado: increased area of effect by 30%
- Mage Infernal Blast: increased area of effect by 25%
- Mage Elemental Armor passive skills (Fire/Cold/Lightning) now gives an additive increase to that element resistance% instead of multiplicative, and also converts a percentage of damage taken into that element.
- Mage Elemental Seal idle mastery: Aura, now lasts up to 30 minutes at max level.

notes.title: Season 2
notes.content:
Season 1 is ending soon, and Season 2 will start again Friday the 9th of December at 18:00 UTC! (13:00 EST, 10:00 PST)

Create a new character and enjoy a fresh new season filled with more items, monsters and challenges to overcome!

New items
Mage will get the long awaited Magic Find set, and you'll find many more unique items for all classes to customize your character.
Experiment with new item builds and hunt for the most rare unique items that you'll find in the higher levels.

Class balance
A lot of feedback has been gathered regarding class balance on Discord, and many of the issues will be addressed. Furthermore, the season 2 leaderboard rewards will be split to rewards for class, so now you'll be able to play any class without worrying about balance issues.

Full Patch notes
Full patch notes will be posted closer to Season 2 start, since we will be working on adding as much content as possible before launch, so stay tuned!

--

Whether you're a competitive RPG player that want's to chase that #1 rank, or a laid-back idle player that wants to grow in power with new builds and items, you'll be pleased to find enough to scratch that itch in Nordicandia.

See you on Friday!

notes.title: Major upcoming changes to the Opals/MTX/IAP system
notes.content:
I understand that many players are not very happy with the current state of microtransactions/in-app-purchases, so I've decided to make some major changes there.

I'm a solo developer, and this is my first game. I don't want to seem like the guy who's trying to get everyone to purchase just to earn money, because that's not why I started this project 20 years ago.

This project is my passion, and I don't have any demands from big publishers to try and fill the game with as much MTX or p2w-aspects as possible, I don't want players to feel forced to purchase anything at all.

In a world where money was not an issue, the game would be free and there wouldn't be any MTX/IAP, but since I have plans for upcoming online features, and the fact that everyone is playing online on a server, I have to cover the server costs in some way.

I understand that the way I've been implementing premium features and opals is not the best from a player perspecitve, but that's why the game is in Early Access so I can listen to feedback and keep improving it.

The following changes will be done:

Character inventory size will be fully unlocked from the start, for free
Pet loot inventory size will be fully unlocked from the start, for free
Adding a second potion slot unlocked, for free
X3 multiplied rewards from Offline xp/loot gains and from End-of-level rewards will be removed
Removing the reset attributes for opals feature, and adding a new item that can drop to reset 100% of the attributes
Giving players 1 free full mastery reset per day, with no way of using opals to reset (reducing p2w-mechanics)
For hardcore players, any unlocks made on a character will carry over to new characters made in that season or game mode, so you only need to unlock things once.
The merchant NPC (with opal purchases) will be removed


I'm also not changing anything to the opal drop rates, so you can continue to gain opals for free just by playing the game, through monster drops, season progress, achievements and more.

I hope this will improve the first impression of the game and make more players feel less "forced" to purchase anything.

All purchases should be voluntary to support the continued development of the game, and I thank everyone who chooses to support it.

Current characters which have unlocked inventory sizes, pet loot sizes and second potion slots will have those opals restored to your game account once the changes go live, so you can spend them on other features. This goes for opals spent on those features for deleted characters too.

I also thank everyone for the feedback on this topic, I'm listening.

Improvements:
- Added notification when a top 50 hardcore player dies on the season leaderboard
- Pressing Esc on PC version when the pause menu is open will close the menu instead of prompting to exit the game
- Made "show chat" button more visible when chat is hidden
- Updated max stack size of Attribute Respec scrolls to 20
- Most of the Relics now have a higher default rarity, these are "new" relics will not stack with the old relics of E rarity
- Moved the fire in Odr's Trail further away after entering the arena
- Default quality at the Essence Blacksmith is now 100% instead of 0%

notes.title: Nordicandia Season 1
notes.content:
Create a new character and start the adventure in the brand new Season game mode, starting September 2nd!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42545121/e68c60b2d7d1d456cba834bda709b4184e059a32.png

Season game mode
A season lasts for 3 months where players can progress and unlock unique rewards, while competing against other players on the leaderboard.

Progression rewards are unlocked as you complete levels, and can be claimed immediately.
Leaderboard rewards are distributed when the season ends.

Hardcore mode
You can also create a hardcore character in the Season, but if your character dies it will be transferred to the Normal game mode.
Hardcore characters have a separate leaderboard with another prize table.

Take this opportunity and join the loot frenzy in Nordicandia!
